SELECT vhcl_sn , reg_no , vhcl_type , mt_id, vhcl_stts , cntr_stts , chck_stts , chck_list , CAST(AES_DECRYPT(FROM_BASE64(oprtr_nm), 'theimc') AS CHAR(100) CHARACTER SET UTF8MB4) AS oprtr_nm , bkdn_cd_list , scr , opr_dstnc FROM anls_vhcl_stts_rt WHERE 1=1 AND use_yn = 'Y' AND junk_yn = 'N' AND chck_stts IN
('1', '2') ('0') ('0','1','2')
AND ownr_nm IN
#{ownr}
and ownr_nm = #{ownrNm}
AND reg_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{regNoInput}, '%')
ORDER BY scr ASC, reg_no ASC

SELECT a.vhcl_sn , a.ownr_nm , a.sys_nm , a.logger_cd , a.dtc , a.anls_dt , a.ocrn_dt , c.msg_cn
FROM anls_vhcl_bkdn_hstry a LEFT JOIN cmm_vhcl_bkdn_info c ON a.sys_nm = c.sys_nm
AND a.dtc = c.dtc WHERE 1=1 AND a.vhcl_sn = #{vhclSn} AND a.ocrn_dt BETWEEN CONCAT(#{searchDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(#{searchDate}, ' 23:59:59')
AND a.ownr_nm = #{currentOwnrNm}
ORDER BY a.anls_dt
SELECT chck_cd , chck_nm , msg_cn , dtl_cn FROM cmm_vhcl_chck_info WHERE 1=1 AND chck_cd = #{chckCd}

SELECT sys_nm , logger_cd , dtc , msg_cn , dtl_cn FROM cmm_vhcl_bkdn_info WHERE 1=1 AND sys_nm = #{sysNm}
AND dtc = #{dtc}

SELECT vhcl_sn , reg_no , vhcl_type , mt_id, vhcl_stts , cntr_stts , chck_stts , chck_list , bkdn_cd_list , scr , opr_dstnc , mdfcn_dt FROM anls_vhcl_stts_rt WHERE 1=1 AND use_yn = 'Y' AND junk_yn = 'N' AND chck_stts = 2
AND ownr_nm IN
#{ownr}
ORDER BY scr asc, reg_no
